sources.title: OAuth应用支持多个重定向URI与Token刷新 / Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
sources.title_zh: OAuth应用支持多个重定向URI与Token刷新
sources.title_en: Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
sources.title_original: Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
sources.summary:
We’ve released multiple updates to the OAuth app and GitHub App platforms to support more secure app development: OAuth apps can opt in to expiring access tokens and refresh tokens.…
We’ve released multiple updates to the OAuth app and GitHub App platforms to support more secure app development:
OAuth apps can now request a short-lived token during the user authentication flow. If an app opts in, they get an access token that lives for eight hours and a refresh token that’s valid for six months.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub为OAuth apps和GitHub Apps发布更新：OAuth apps可选用八小时访问令牌与六个月刷新令牌，并注册最多十个回调URI；两者均可启用通配符匹配。注意单URI应用的默认通配符，建议审查。

items.title: AI生成书籍正淹没亚马逊，并拉低人类作者的单书收入 / AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors

sources.title: AI生成书籍正淹没亚马逊，并拉低人类作者的单书收入 / AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
sources.title_zh: AI生成书籍正淹没亚马逊，并拉低人类作者的单书收入
sources.title_en: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
sources.title_original: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
sources.summary: 一项对14，419本自出版电子书的分析显示，AI生成书籍正以数量而非质量挤占人类作者市场，即便未检测到AI文本的书籍，单书收入也在下滑。2023年Q1至2026年Q1，书目总量增长38.3倍，而季度收入仅增长8.9倍；在八个类型中，七个类型的无AI文本书籍单书收入下降。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 一项对Amazon上14,419本自出版书籍的研究显示，AI生成书占目录20%却仅贡献12%销售额，且人类作者在八个类型中有七个每本收入下降，为AI版权诉讼提供了市场损害数据。

sources.title_original: AI in drug discovery – what it is, where we stand and the path forward
sources.summary: For example, it helps me install academic software, debug things. It helps me take a large dataset and write scripts to ask questions. It helps me go through experiment drafts to see if I'm missing things. It helps me remember obscure formulas I use every 6 months. It has not, at least in my experience, come up with anything truly novel. A concrete example: AlphaFold is great...to come up with a starting model for a chimeric fusion or something. What would have taken me 1-2 hours fumbling around
sources.recommend_reason_zh: AlphaFold将嵌合融合蛋白的起始模型构建从1-2小时的PDB/CIF文件摸索缩短为一次快速提示，但作者坦言AI尚未带来真正新颖的产出，本文就此评估了药物发现中AI的实际能力与局限。
